cards.text: After Aaron's staff sprouted almonds, the Israelites said, “Anyone who comes near the tabernacle of the LORD will die.” (Numbers 17:8, 13) So the LORD speaks to Aaron, Israel's priest and the brother of Moses, Israel's leader (Exodus 28:1). He starts heavy: Aaron, his sons and his father's house must bear the iniquity involving the sanctuary.

cards.question: God also says who must bear the iniquity involving the priesthood. Who is it?

answers.text: The leaders of all twelve tribes

cards.text: But Aaron isn't running this solo, friend. God tells him to bring his brothers from the tribe of Levi, his father's tribe.

cards.question: God says those Levites will join Aaron and ___ him and his sons before the Tent of the Testimony.

cards.text: The Levites will attend to Aaron's duties and to ALL the duties of the Tent, like the new hire whose job list ends with one line: also, everything else. But there's one line they can NOT cross.

cards.question: What must the Levites not come near?

answers.text: The furnishings of the sanctuary and the altar
The poles and the outer curtains of the Tent
The courtyard gate in front of the Tent

cards.question: If the Levites come near the furnishings of the sanctuary or the altar, only the Levites will die.

cards.text: The Levites will join Aaron and attend to all the work at the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron attends to the duties of the sanctuary and the altar. Clear lanes, friend, like a kitchen where everybody knows whose oven is whose.

cards.question: Why does God put Aaron on the duties of the sanctuary and the altar?

answers.text: So wrath may not fall on the Israelites again
So the tribes may not quarrel over the altar again
So the Levites may not carry the load alone again

cards.text: Then God says, “Behold, I Myself have selected your fellow Levites from the Israelites…” I'm leaning in, friend, because this is either a compliment or a chore chart.

cards.question: God says He selected the Levites as a ___ to Aaron, dedicated to the LORD to serve at the Tent of Meeting.

cards.text: But only Aaron and his sons serve as priests for everything concerning the altar and what's inside the veil. That's a door with one family's name on it, friend, and NOBODY else is getting a copy of the key.

cards.question: God tells Aaron that the work of the priesthood is a gift too.
What happens to any outsider who comes near the sanctuary?

answers.text: They must be put to death
They must bring a guilt offering
They must leave the camp for a week

cards.text: Then God puts Aaron in charge of His offerings and lists what goes to his family: parts of the most holy offerings, the wave offerings, the firstfruits, every devoted thing and the firstborn. Firstborn sons and firstborn males of unclean animals must be redeemed, at five shekels of silver for a month-old male, but the firstborn of an ox, a sheep or a goat are holy and must not be redeemed. Somebody once paid a quarter to take me home from a closing bakery's bin, friend, so I'm in NO position to comment on prices. God calls it all a permanent covenant of salt before the LORD for Aaron and his offspring.

Then the LORD tells Aaron, “You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any portion among them.” No land, friend, and even in the junk drawer I spent years stuck in, I had a little spot behind the takeout menus.

cards.question: So what does God say is Aaron's portion and inheritance among the Israelites?

cards.text: Next, God tells Aaron what the Levites get in return for their work, the service of the Tent of Meeting. Friend, I worked years on the kitchen counter of the Millers, the family who took me home, and got paid in flour to the face.

cards.question: In return for their work at the Tent of Meeting, God gives the Levites all the ___ in Israel as an inheritance.

cards.text: Then God says no longer may the Israelites come near the Tent of Meeting.

cards.question: What does God say will happen if the Israelites come near the Tent of Meeting?

answers.text: They will incur guilt and die
They will lose their share of the land
They will be sent out of the camp

cards.text: The Levites do the work of the Tent of Meeting and bear their iniquity, a permanent statute for the generations to come. They get NO inheritance among the Israelites, because God gave them the tithe as their inheritance.

Then the LORD tells Moses to speak to the Levites, and here's the twist: the folks who RECEIVE the tithe have to give from it too. That's like your paycheck clearing and your first move is writing a check.

cards.question: How much of the tithe do the Levites present as an offering to the LORD?

cards.text: God says their offering will be reckoned to them as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress. Hold onto that line, friend.

cards.question: Who receives the LORD's offering from the Levites' tithes?
The Levites present the offering due the LORD from all the ___ of every gift.

cards.text: God says it again: once they've presented the best part, it's reckoned to them as the produce of the threshing floor or winepress. That line again, friend, and when God says something twice, I write it on my apron.

cards.question: The Levites and their households may eat the rest of the tithe only at the Tent of Meeting.

cards.text: Once they've presented the best part, they won't incur guilt because of it. But God ends with a warning about the sacred offerings of the Israelites, and friend, when the last line of the recipe is a warning, you read it TWICE.

cards.question: What happens if the Levites defile the sacred offerings of the Israelites?
